title: Ryan Prepared for the 90-Day Blackout (It Was a 1-Minute Test)
description: Ryan believed the viral November 17 '90-day blackout' rumour and bought 40 candles and 200 cans of beans. Maya traces the rumour to its four ingredients — a one-minute Emergency Alert System test, a Simpsons episode, the Pentagon's FORTRESS plan and a week of outages — explains how the US power grid really works, and what preparing for a real outage actually looks like.
